llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: Add a required field RetryConfig RetrySettings to the exporter.Settings struct. Every exporter factory in otel-contrib and Jaeger receives Settings when creating exporter instances. All callers constructing Settings literals will break.

FILES:
- otel-contrib/exporter/settings.go — Add required field to struct
- otel-contrib/exporter/factory.go — Update factory implementations
- Jaeger/exporter/settings.go — Add required field to struct
- Jaeger/exporter/factory.go — Update factory implementations
